report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; metrics show zero 502s and no dependency errors. No failure signature matches the taxonomy. The alert lacks a defined threshold, so no root cause can be substantiated; more evidence is required.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error metrics over a longer window to confirm whether checkout p95 ~98ms is anomalous vs baseline
Downstream dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres) to attribute the ~80ms checkout duration
Baseline SLO/latency thresholds for /v1/checkout to determine if observed durations constitute an incident
